source_event.finding: persistent alert lifecycle ignored material transitions after the first open

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A stateful processor opens a persistent alert during initial object creation but does not reevaluate alert identity after later material severity, range, or expiry transitions, so the persistent operational signal becomes stale.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: The happy path creates an initial alert and makes that creation idempotent, while all later reconciliations skip alert evaluation because the parent state already exists.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: For persistent alerts or incidents, derive a stable event identity for every material transition after initial creation and persist at most one reopen/update per identity; renewed horizons must receive independent expiry identities.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Begin with the parent and initial alert already persisted, then exercise a material severity/range transition, an unresolved expiry, a same-event retry, and a renewed horizon; require exactly one new alert event per material identity and zero retry duplicates.

transfer_cases.evidence: Generic contract fixture exercises an already-open incident whose measured range crosses a higher threshold and requires one idempotent escalation.
Generic contract fixture exercises an already-open review task across expiry and a renewed expiry horizon, requiring independent idempotent event identities.
